svg.title: rear_A4_3hp_REAR_FULL_FROST_CLEAR_LETTERS
svg.desc: Appearance/mask revision on A3 hole geometry; mechanical release pending stocked switch/jack selection. Rear face up; keep TOP at TOP. Already mirrored X=W-X. Black filled regions are ENGRAVE. Transparent omissions are clear letter strokes, hidden seating exclusions, and through-holes. Counter islands in O/D/P remain black and must be engraved. Do not mirror or invert again. Full 1:1 mm artboard; no cropping, no etch depth, no laser parameters.
